title: 虚拟与真实的边界
text:
咖啡馆里，几个人相对而坐，却各自低头盯着发光的屏幕。这种沉默的场景在当代都市极为普遍。数字设备将全球连接在一起，却在物理空间制造了隔阂。人们习惯于通过社交软件维持联系，认为点赞即是关心。然而，屏幕过滤掉了真实的体温与眼神交流。虚拟世界的互动往往碎片化，缺乏深度。我们追求沟通的效率，却忽视了情感的细腻。
这种技术依赖导致了社交能力的退化。面对面的对话需要处理复杂的实时反馈，而线上交流允许人们反复编辑文字。在这种保护壳下，个体变得胆小且焦虑。当真实的社交压力袭来，许多人感到无所适从。科技本应是工具，如今却成了主宰生活的中心。
我们需要反思数字时代的生存状态。过度沉溺于虚拟社交，会使人产生深刻的孤独感。真正的亲密关系建立在共同经历的真实体验之上。无论是共同散步还是深入交谈，这些行为不可替代。
回归现实生活并非要求抛弃科技，而是寻求一种平衡。应当有意识地划定电子产品的使用界限。在用餐或聚会时，尝试将手机放置一旁。关注眼前人的情绪，倾听对方的声音。只有走出虚拟的幻象，才能重新感受生命的质感。找回真实的在场感，是治愈现代精神内耗的关键。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does technology dependence lead to regarding people's social skills?
options: A dramatic improvement in social skills
A degradation of social skills
No noticeable change in social skills
The complete elimination of any need for social skills

questions.prompt: According to the text, what key difference distinguishes face-to-face conversation from online communication?
options: Face-to-face requires handling real-time feedback, while online allows repeated editing of text
Face-to-face is always faster to complete than online communication
Online communication requires more physical presence
There is no meaningful difference between the two, according to the text

questions.prompt: According to the text, what do screens filter out, even as digital devices connect the globe together?
options: Internet connection speed
Real body warmth and eye contact
Financial transaction costs
Time zone differences

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does "returning to real life" explicitly NOT mean?
options: It does not mean abandoning technology altogether, only finding balance
It means deleting every social media account
It means moving somewhere without internet access
It means avoiding screens permanently

questions.prompt: According to the text, what concrete suggestion is given for practicing this balance during meals or gatherings?
options: Recording every meal for social media
Consciously putting the phone aside and focusing on the person present
Always keeping the phone in hand for safety reasons
Making technology the main topic of conversation

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
